manifest_rewrites.reason: Basalt's nested UCAN snapshot is omitted; the root shell resolves to Kiln's single vendored cohort.
ucan-core resolves to Kiln's single vendored cohort.
ucan-nostr resolves to Kiln's single vendored cohort.

consumer_profile: kiln-adapter-basalt depends on basalt with default-features = false. The oidc-exchange and durable-authority features (and their git-sourced optional dependencies) are disabled, so the read-only authority adapter never acquires them.
scope: Basalt's reviewed crate source, packaged policy contracts, license text and the Kiln authority adapter documentation. The nested UCAN snapshot, release tooling, tests and examples are omitted; the three UCAN path dependencies are rewritten to the single Kiln snapshot.
nonclaims: This local immutable import is not remote publication, source authority, source trust, or release eligibility. A Basalt checkout is needed only to reproduce the import, never to build Kiln.
